title: English Practice Quiz 0689
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: She said, 'Please sit down.'
options: She asked me to sit down.
questions.explanation: A request can be reported with asked + object + to-infinitive.

questions.question: A person who repairs water pipes is a ___.
questions.explanation: A plumber installs and repairs water pipes and fittings.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
The windows ___ every week.
questions.explanation: Plural subject windows takes are + past participle.

questions.question: They ___ football every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Use the base verb with the plural subject they in the present simple.

questions.question: You need a moment to think. You say:
options: Let me think for a moment.
questions.explanation: This phrase politely signals that you need a little time.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'They clean the room.'
options: The room is cleaned by them.
questions.explanation: Present simple passive: am/is/are + past participle.

questions.question: At 8 p.m. yesterday, I ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress at a specific past time.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use there are with plural nouns.

questions.question: If I had more time, I ___ another language.
questions.explanation: The second conditional uses would + base verb for an unreal or imagined situation.
